name: Sora o Tobu, 3tsu no Houhou.
source:
"Can you fly?
Can I fly?
How do you fly?"

Kakeru is an ordinary high school student. One day, he was going to school as usual, but as he got there he saw lots of toy soldiers storming the building. He is lead to a classroom with some other students, still baffled at what was going on. 

Suddenly, a schoolgirl storms into the classroom and says "Sorry, we've occupied your school. If you don't want to die, please fly in one month."

Everyone is shocked, but take the news enthusiastically. They have a party to get acquainted, and their month starts...
translation:
“你会飞吗？
我会飞吗？
要怎样才能飞翔？”

翔是一名普通高中生。一天，他像往常一样去学校，却发现大批玩具士兵正冲进校舍。他仍不明白发生了什么，就被带到一间教室，与其他学生关在一起。

突然，一名女学生冲进教室说道：“抱歉，我们占领了你们的学校。如果不想死，请在一个月内学会飞翔。”

所有人都大吃一惊，却也热情地接受了这个消息。他们举行聚会相互认识，而属于他们的一个月就此开始……
